note: The base design of one lighting state; art/palettes/<mm>/ holds what each month shows. The position in 'colors' is the palette index used by every art PNG. The first 22 (the dog's 15 and the props' 7) never move; the scene's roles are renumbered when one is dropped, and every layer is rewritten with them. A kept role's colour here is the truth; a computed role's is rewritten by every build (tools/scene_build.py says which). Index 0 is transparent.
